audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for Bethel return, foreign gods purification, terror of God, Deborah's burial, Jacob/Israel name reaffirmed, Rachel's death, Benjamin naming, Reuben/Bilhah household violation notice, twelve sons list, and Isaac's death.

verses.restored: The Divine said to Jacob, Rise, go up to Bethel and dwell there. Make there an altar to the Divine who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.

familiar.text: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel...

notes.title: Return to Bethel
notes.body: Jacob is sent back to the vow-place where the promise of return began.

modern.text: Then God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and settle there. Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֔ב ק֛וּם עֲלֵ֥ה בֵֽית אֵ֖ל וְשֶׁב שָׁ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂה שָׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לָאֵל֙ הַנִּרְאֶ֣ה אֵלֶ֔יךָ בְּבָרְחֲךָ֔ מִפְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִֽיךָ

verses.restored: Jacob said to his house and to all who were with him, Remove the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

familiar.text: Then Jacob said unto his household... Put away the strange gods...

modern.text: So Jacob told his household and all who were with him, “Get rid of the foreign gods that are among you. Purify yourselves and change your garments.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל בֵּית֔וֹ וְאֶ֖ל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑וֹ הָסִ֜רוּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּתֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהִֽטַּהֲר֔וּ וְהַחֲלִ֖יפוּ שִׂמְלֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Let us rise and go up to Bethel. There I will make an altar to the Divine who answered me in the day of my distress and was with me in the way that I went.

familiar.text: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel...

modern.text: Then let us arise and go to Bethel. I will build an altar there to God, who answered me in my day of distress. He has been with me wherever I have gone.”

original.text: וְנָק֥וּמָה וְנַעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה שָּׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֗חַ לָאֵ֞ל הָעֹנֶ֤ה אֹתִי֙ בְּי֣וֹם צָֽרָתִ֔י וַיְהִי֙ עִמָּדִ֔י בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽכְתִּי

verses.restored: They gave Jacob all the foreign gods that were in their hand and the rings that were in their ears, and Jacob hid them under the terebinth that was near Shechem.

familiar.text: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods...

modern.text: So they gave Jacob all their foreign gods and all their earrings, and Jacob buried them under the oak near Shechem.

original.text: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֗ב אֵ֣ת כָּל אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדָ֔ם וְאֶת הַנְּזָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאָזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּטְמֹ֤ן אֹתָם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב תַּ֥חַת הָאֵלָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם שְׁכֶֽם

verses.restored: They journeyed, and a terror of the Divine was upon the cities around them, so they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.

familiar.text: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities...

modern.text: As they set out, a terror from God fell over the surrounding cities, so that they did not pursue Jacob’s sons.

original.text: וַיִּסָּ֑עוּ וַיְהִ֣י חִתַּ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַל הֶֽעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א רָֽדְפ֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב

verses.restored: Jacob came to Luz, that is Bethel, in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

familiar.text: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan...

modern.text: So Jacob and everyone with him arrived in Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב ל֗וּזָה אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן הִ֖וא בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל ה֖וּא וְכָל הָעָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר עִמּֽוֹ

verses.restored: He built an altar there and called the place El-Bethel, because there the Divine had been revealed to him when he fled from the face of his brother.

familiar.text: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel...

notes.title: El-Bethel
notes.body: El-Bethel means God/the Divine of Bethel.

modern.text: There Jacob built an altar, and he called that place El-bethel, because it was there that God had revealed Himself to Jacob as he fled from his brother.

original.text: וַיִּ֤בֶן שָׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּקְרָא֙ לַמָּק֔וֹם אֵ֖ל בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם נִגְל֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בְּבָרְח֖וֹ מִפְּנֵ֥י אָחִֽיו

verses.restored: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak. He called its name Allon-bacuth.

familiar.text: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died...

notes.title: Allon-bacuth
notes.body: The name means oak of weeping.

modern.text: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak below Bethel. So Jacob named it Allon-bachuth.

original.text: וַתָּ֤מָת דְּבֹרָה֙ מֵינֶ֣קֶת רִבְקָ֔ה וַתִּקָּבֵ֛ר מִתַּ֥חַת לְבֵֽית אֵ֖ל תַּ֣חַת הָֽאַלּ֑וֹן וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וֹן בָּכֽוּת

verses.restored: The Divine appeared to Jacob again when he came from Paddan-Aram, and blessed him.

familiar.text: And God appeared unto Jacob again...

modern.text: After Jacob had returned from Paddan-aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.

original.text: וַיֵּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֶֽל יַעֲקֹב֙ ע֔וֹד בְּבֹא֖וֹ מִפַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַיְבָ֖רֶךְ אֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: The Divine said to him, Your name is Jacob; your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name. And he called his name Israel.

familiar.text: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob...

modern.text: And God said to him, “Though your name is Jacob, you will no longer be called Jacob. Instead, your name will be Israel. ” So God named him Israel.

original.text: וַיֹּֽאמֶר ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים שִׁמְךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֑ב לֹֽא יִקָּרֵא֩ שִׁמְךָ֨ ע֜וֹד יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּ֤י אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: The Divine said to him, I am El Shaddai. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and an assembly of nations shall come from you, and kings shall go out from your loins.

familiar.text: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty...

modern.text: And God told him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation—even a company of nations—shall come from you, and kings shall descend from you.

original.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֲנִ֨י אֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ פְּרֵ֣ה וּרְבֵ֔ה גּ֛וֹי וּקְהַ֥ל גּוֹיִ֖ם יִהְיֶ֣ה מִמֶּ֑ךָּ וּמְלָכִ֖ים מֵחֲלָצֶ֥יךָ יֵצֵֽאוּ

verses.restored: The land that I gave to Abraham and to Isaac I will give to you, and to your seed after you I will give the land.

familiar.text: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac...

modern.text: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you.”

original.text: וְאֶת הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛תִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם וּלְיִצְחָ֖ק לְךָ֣ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַחֲרֶ֖יךָ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: The Divine went up from him in the place where he had spoken with him.

familiar.text: And God went up from him...

modern.text: Then God went up from the place where He had spoken with him.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַל מֵעָלָ֖יו אֱלֹהִ֑ים בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he had spoken with him, a pillar of stone, and poured a drink offering on it and poured oil on it.

familiar.text: And Jacob set up a pillar...

modern.text: So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where God had spoken with him—a stone marker—and he poured out a drink offering on it and anointed it with oil.

original.text: וַיַּצֵּ֨ב יַעֲקֹ֜ב מַצֵּבָ֗ה בַּמָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ מַצֶּ֣בֶת אָ֑בֶן וַיַּסֵּ֤ךְ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ נֶ֔סֶךְ וַיִּצֹ֥ק עָלֶ֖יהָ שָֽׁמֶן

verses.restored: Jacob called the name of the place where the Divine had spoken with him Bethel.

familiar.text: And Jacob called the name of the place... Bethel.

modern.text: Jacob called the place where God had spoken with him Bethel. Benjamin Born, Rachel Dies

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר אִתּ֥וֹ שָׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בֵּֽית אֵֽל

verses.restored: They journeyed from Bethel, and while there was still some distance to Ephrath, Rachel gave birth, and her labor was hard.

familiar.text: And they journeyed from Bethel... Rachel travailed...

modern.text: Later, they set out from Bethel, and while they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth, and her labor was difficult.

original.text: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית אֵ֔ל וַֽיְהִי ע֥וֹד כִּבְרַת הָאָ֖רֶץ לָב֣וֹא אֶפְרָ֑תָה וַתֵּ֥לֶד רָחֵ֖ל וַתְּקַ֥שׁ בְּלִדְתָּֽהּ

verses.restored: When her labor was hard, the midwife said to her, Do not fear, for this also is a son for you.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour...

modern.text: During her severe labor, the midwife said to her, “Do not be afraid, for you are having another son.”

original.text: וַיְהִ֥י בְהַקְשֹׁתָ֖הּ בְּלִדְתָּ֑הּ וַתֹּ֨אמֶר לָ֤הּ הַמְיַלֶּ֨דֶת֙ אַל תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כִּֽי גַם זֶ֥ה לָ֖ךְ בֵּֽן

verses.restored: As her life was departing, for she died, she called his name Ben-oni; but his father called him Benjamin.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing...

notes.title: Ben-oni / Benjamin
notes.body: Rachel names him son of my sorrow/strength; Jacob renames him son of the right hand/south.

modern.text: And with her last breath—for she was dying—she named him Ben-oni. But his father called him Benjamin.

original.text: וַיְהִ֞י בְּצֵ֤את נַפְשָׁהּ֙ כִּ֣י מֵ֔תָה וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֶּן אוֹנִ֑י וְאָבִ֖יו קָֽרָא ל֥וֹ בִנְיָמִֽין

verses.restored: Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath, that is Bethlehem.

familiar.text: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath...

modern.text: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).

original.text: וַתָּ֖מָת רָחֵ֑ל וַתִּקָּבֵר֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶפְרָ֔תָה הִ֖וא בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם

verses.restored: Jacob set up a pillar over her burial place; it is the pillar of Rachel’s burial place to this day.

familiar.text: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave...

modern.text: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave; it marks Rachel’s tomb to this day. The Sons of Jacob (1 Chronicles 2:1–2)

original.text: וַיַּצֵּ֧ב יַעֲקֹ֛ב מַצֵּבָ֖ה עַל קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ הִ֛וא מַצֶּ֥בֶת קְבֻֽרַת רָחֵ֖ל עַד הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: Israel journeyed and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

familiar.text: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

modern.text: Israel again set out and pitched his tent beyond the Tower of Eder.

original.text: וַיִּסַּ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֣ט אָֽהֳלֹ֔ה מֵהָ֖לְאָה לְמִגְדַּל עֵֽדֶר

verses.restored: While Israel was dwelling in that land, Reuben violated the household boundary with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went...

notes.title: Reuben and Bilhah
notes.body: The source is brief but grave; later tradition treats this as a serious challenge to the father’s household authority and Reuben’s standing.

modern.text: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard about it. Jacob had twelve sons:

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י בִּשְׁכֹּ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔וא וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ רְאוּבֵ֔ן וַיִּשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת בִּלְהָה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אָבִ֔יו וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר

verses.restored: The sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

familiar.text: The sons of Leah; Reuben...

modern.text: The sons of Leah were Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

original.text: בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֔ה בְּכ֥וֹר יַעֲקֹ֖ב רְאוּבֵ֑ן וְשִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְלֵוִ֣י וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וּזְבוּלֻֽן

verses.restored: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

familiar.text: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

modern.text: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

original.text: בְּנֵ֣י רָחֵ֔ל יוֹסֵ֖ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן

verses.restored: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s slave-woman: Dan and Naphtali.

familiar.text: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid...

modern.text: The sons of Rachel’s maidservant Bilhah were Dan and Naphtali.

original.text: וּבְנֵ֤י בִלְהָה֙ שִׁפְחַ֣ת רָחֵ֔ל דָּ֖ן וְנַפְתָּלִֽי

verses.restored: The sons of Zilpah, Leah’s slave-woman: Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Paddan-Aram.

familiar.text: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid...

modern.text: And the sons of Leah’s maidservant Zilpah were Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan-aram. The Death of Isaac

original.text: וּבְנֵ֥י זִלְפָּ֛ה שִׁפְחַ֥ת לֵאָ֖ה גָּ֣ד וְאָשֵׁ֑ר אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּד ל֖וֹ בְּפַדַּ֥ן אֲרָֽם

verses.restored: Jacob came to Isaac his father at Mamre, to Kiriath-arba, that is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac had sojourned.

familiar.text: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre...

modern.text: Jacob returned to his father Isaac at Mamre, near Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֤א יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֔יו מַמְרֵ֖א קִרְיַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבַּ֑ע הִ֣וא חֶבְר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר גָּֽר שָׁ֥ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְיִצְחָֽק

verses.restored: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

familiar.text: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

modern.text: And Isaac lived 180 years.

original.text: וַיִּֽהְי֖וּ יְמֵ֣י יִצְחָ֑ק מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֖ה וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה

verses.restored: Isaac expired and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.

familiar.text: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died...

modern.text: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

original.text: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע יִצְחָ֤ק וַיָּ֨מָת֙ וַיֵּאָ֣סֶף אֶל עַמָּ֔יו זָקֵ֖ן וּשְׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ עֵשָׂ֥ו וְיַעֲקֹ֖ב בָּנָֽיו
